text:
oliver-marketing: hey @ali-runtime quick one for launch week: need a short parity run to validate numbers for the blog + confirm lead-routing SLA.

oliver-marketing: scope: embed->rerank pipeline, cohort ~180, compare fp32 vs int8. want p50/p90/p99/p999, throughput, and one example where rerank order is unchanged (slide-ready). also include a tiny note about how long artifacts will be available for support.

ali-runtime: got it. payload mix? long/short split? and are we scoring (ndcg) or just ordinality for the slide example?

oliver-marketing: split 65% short (<150t) / 35% long (1k-3k). include ndcg@10 for rerank, but for the marketing slide we only need one preserved-order example. artifacts should be downloadable for 7 days.

maya-eng: timeline: we can do a smoke tonight and a full run tomorrow evening. smoke will include p50/p90/p99 and one slide example per variant.

sam-devex: tagging: campaign=launch-q3, funnel=webinar, route=leads. please add sample_tag and warmup=true/false spans so analytics can map. also we need metric ids in README.

ali-runtime: will include tags: campaign=launch-q3,funnel=webinar,route=leads and span annotations warmup=true/false; README will include latency_metric_id and ndcg_metric_id.

ali-runtime: run command for repro:
```
run_bench --cohort launch_parity_pack.json \
          --models rwin-open-7b-fp32 rwin-open-7b-int8 \
          --warmup 25 --samples 180 --concurrency 6 \
          --scoring ndcg@10 --trace-tags "campaign=launch-q3,route=leads" \
          --output artifacts/2222223333-parity.tar.gz
```

bench-bot: Job queued
 id=62901 queue=staging-bench variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8] cohort=180 longpct=35 ETA smoke=2024-07-10T02:00Z.

ops-bot: Note: artifacts available at https://files.redwood.local/artifacts/2222223333-parity.tar.gz for 7 days (access: marketing-team).

ali-runtime: we'll capture per-request latencies (p50/p90/p99/p999), token throughput, kernel timings, sample_id for slide examples, and 8 tail snapshots per variant. we'll scrub PII before export.

maya-eng: if int8 shows >15% p99 regression vs fp32 we'll snapshot kernel profiles and escalate. otherwise we'll attach a short note in README about any observed regressions.

oliver-marketing: perfect. smoke by tomorrow 02:00Z is ideal so design can iterate. if full sweep slips, ship smoke artifacts + one quantized example.
